description: Each college's income is divided by the total of all income records, whether or not they link to a college.

c.request: Linking each income record through the member who brought it in to that member's major, show each college with its total income amount and what fraction of the total income that represents, without rounding. Each college's income is divided by the total of all income records, whether or not they link to a college.
c.sql: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) as total_income, SUM(i.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction FROM income i LEFT JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id LEFT JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college

d.request: For each college, display the total income from members whose major is in that college and the fraction of that total divided by the sum of all income records in the database, without rounding.
d.sql: SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.college

b.request: For each college, sum income amounts from members with majors in that college, then divide each college's total by the grand total of all income records (including income from members without a linked major or college), displaying college name, total income, and fraction without rounding.
b.sql: SELECT maj.college, SUM(inc.amount) as total_income, SUM(inc.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction FROM income inc JOIN member mem ON inc.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id GROUP BY maj.college
b.raw: For each college, sum income amounts from members with majors in that college, then divide each college's total by the grand total of all income records (including income from members without a linked major or college), displaying college name, total income, and fraction without rounding.

a.request: Link each income record to the member who brought it in and to that member's major, dropping any income that does not link up. For each college of those majors, show the college, the total income amount, and that total as a fraction of the total amount of all income records (including income not matched to any college), without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) as fraction FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.college
